mainTopic: The order of offerings: חטאת versus עולה, a three-way circle of offerings, the order of eating קדשים, and תדיר versus מקודש.
overview: The amud continues the question of whether a חטאת or an עולה is offered first. The גמרא challenges the rule that a חטאת comes first from two ברייתות. One lists bulls, rams, sheep and goats, read as the קרבנות of סוכות. The other puts the bull for עבודה זרה, an עולה, before its goats, which are חטאות. The first ברייתא is explained as being about נדבה offerings. The second is explained as a special case: either the word 'לחטת' is missing an א, or the פסוק says 'כמשפט' and fixes the order. That same idea of 'כמשפטם' lets the first ברייתא be about סוכות after all. Next the גמרא asks about three offerings that beat each other in a circle: a bird חטאת, an animal עולה, and מעשר. בבל and ארץ ישראל each break the circle in a different way. A new משנה then teaches that חטאות come before אשמות, gives the age and value of an אשם, and says that what is offered first is also eaten first. It also says the כהנים may cook the meat as they like, with a מחלוקת about adding תרומה spices. The גמרא opens by asking whether a תדיר offering or a holier offering comes first, and starts testing it from תמידין before מוספין. That test continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Is the animal list about the סוכות offerings?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא suggests that the ברייתא listing bulls, rams, sheep and goats is talking about the מוספין of סוכות.
steps.simpleTranslation: What, is it not talking about the offerings of the festival (סוכות)?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the rule that a חטאת comes before an עולה. It does this by reading the ברייתא as talking about the סוכות offerings, where the goat חטאות come after the sheep עולות.
steps.deeperAnalysis: On סוכות the bulls, rams and sheep are עולות, and the goat is a חטאת. If the ברייתא puts goats last, that would mean the עולה goes before the חטאת.

keyTerms.meaning: What, is it not...? A formula the גמרא uses to suggest a reading.
A burnt offering, burned completely on the מזבח

phrases.english: What, is it not about the festival?
phrases.notes: He means the מוספין of סוכות, where the bulls, rams and sheep are עולות and the goat is a חטאת.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the earlier discussion of whether a חטאת or an עולה takes precedence, by reading a ברייתא that comes before this section.
steps.raayaObject: That an עולה is offered before a חטאת
steps.raayaSupportSource: The ברייתא ranking bulls, then rams, then sheep, then goats, read as the סוכות offerings
steps.kashyaTarget: The earlier ruling that a חטאת (even a bird חטאת) is offered before an עולה

steps.title: No, the list is about gift offerings
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects the סוכות reading. The ברייתא is talking about נדבה offerings.
steps.simpleTranslation: No, it is talking about gift offerings.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back on the proof. The ברייתא is not about סוכות but about voluntary offerings.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If every animal in the list is a נדבה עולה, then there is no חטאת in the list at all. So the ברייתא tells us nothing about חטאת versus עולה.

keyTerms.meaning: No. The opening of a rejection.

phrases.english: No, it is about gift offerings.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge in step 1 by changing which case the ברייתא is about.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the reading that the ברייתא is about the סוכות offerings
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The ברייתא can be read as all נדבה offerings, so no חטאת is involved

steps.title: Why bulls come before rams, sheep and goats
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא explains the order of the ברייתא under the נדבה reading. More נסכים, or an extra part burned (the אליה), gives priority.
steps.simpleTranslation: Bulls come before rams, because they get more נסכים. Likewise rams come before sheep. Sheep come before goats, because they have more burned on the מזבח, the tail.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows that the ברייתא's order makes sense without any חטאת. Each animal comes first because it gets more on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A bull gets more wine, flour and oil than a ram, and a ram gets more than a sheep. A sheep and a goat get the same נסכים, but a sheep's tail is burned on the מזבח and a goat's is not. So the order is about which קרבן has more, not about עולה versus חטאת.

keyTerms.meaning: Wine libations, along with the flour and oil offering that come with a קרבן
They have more, they were increased
The fat tail of a sheep, which is burned on the מזבח

steps.whatToRemember: Under the נדבה reading, the order is set by which animal has more on the מזבח: more נסכים, or the extra אליה. It has nothing to do with חטאת versus עולה.

phrases.english: Bulls come before rams –
because they have more libations.
And likewise rams come before sheep.
Sheep come before goats –
because they have more, with the tail.

steps.triggerLanguage: פָּרִים קוֹדְמִין לְאֵילִים שֶׁכֵּן נִתְרַבּוּ בִּנְסָכִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Backs up the rejection in step 2 by giving a reason for every link in the ברייתא's order.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Reinterpretation: the order is explained by how much each animal gets on the מזבח
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The goats come last because they are a חטאת and the others are עולות
steps.terutzMaskana: All the animals are נדבה עולות. The order follows more נסכים and the אליה.

steps.title: The bull for idol worship comes before the goats
steps.stepSummary: A new ברייתא ranks the communal bulls. It puts פר עבודה זרה, an עולה, before שעירי עבודה זרה, which are חטאות.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: The bull of the כהן משיח comes before the bull of a communal mistake (פר העלם דבר של צבור). The bull of a communal mistake comes before the bull for idol worship. The bull for idol worship comes before the goats for idol worship. This is true even though the bull for idol worship is an עולה and the goats for idol worship are חטאות!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a new ברייתא that seems to contradict the rule that a חטאת always comes before an עולה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: When the community sins by mistake with עבודה זרה, they bring a bull as an עולה and a goat as a חטאת. The ברייתא says the bull goes first. So here an עולה clearly comes before a חטאת.

keyTerms.meaning: The anointed כהן, the כהן גדול
The bull brought when the בית דין rules wrongly and the community acts on it

steps.confusionAlert: The bull for עבודה זרה is an עולה, not a חטאת, even though it comes to atone for a sin. Its partner, the goat, is the חטאת.

phrases.english: Come and hear:
The bull of the anointed priest comes before
the bull for a hidden matter of the community,
phrases.notes: "Hidden matter" means a mistaken ruling of the בית דין that the community acted on.

phrases.english: the bull for a hidden matter of the community
comes before the bull for idol worship,
the bull for idol worship comes before
the goats for idol worship.

phrases.aramaic: דְּאַף עַל גַּב דְּפַר עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה עוֹלָה,
phrases.english: This is so even though the bull for idol worship is a burnt offering,
and the goats for idol worship are sin offerings!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the first proof was pushed off, the גמרא tries a new source for the same question.
steps.raayaObject: That an עולה is offered before a חטאת
steps.raayaSupportSource: The ברייתא ranking פר עבודה זרה (an עולה) before שעירי עבודה זרה (חטאות)
steps.kashyaTarget: The rule that a חטאת is offered before an עולה, even across different species

steps.title: The first clause of the same ברייתא shows the opposite
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא points to the start of that same ברייתא. There, פר העלם דבר, a חטאת, comes before פר עבודה זרה, an עולה.
steps.simpleTranslation: But say it from the first clause: the bull of a communal mistake comes before the bull for idol worship!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the proof by turning to the beginning of the same ברייתא, which seems to say the opposite.
steps.deeperAnalysis: פר העלם דבר של צבור is a חטאת, and פר עבודה זרה is an עולה. Since the ברייתא puts the חטאת first there, it cannot be a clear proof that the עולה always comes first. The two clauses pull in opposite directions.
steps.whatToRemember: The same ברייתא has a חטאת before an עולה at the start, and an עולה before a חטאת at the end. So it cannot settle the question by itself.

phrases.english: But say it from the first clause:
the bull for a hidden matter of the community
phrases.notes: This bull is a חטאת, and the bull for idol worship is an עולה.

phrases.english: comes before the bull for idol worship!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge in step 4 by showing that the same ברייתא's first clause points the other way.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects using this ברייתא as proof that an עולה comes before a חטאת
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The ברייתא's first clause puts a חטאת (פר העלם דבר) before an עולה (פר עבודה זרה)

steps.title: The real problem is with two kinds of animals
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects Step 5's answer. Inside one species a חטאת comes first, and nobody doubted that. The problem is across two species, where a bull עולה comes before goat חטאות.
steps.simpleTranslation: When both offerings are the same kind of animal, we never said there was a question. Of course the חטאת comes first. Our question is about two different kinds of animals. There we found a עולה that comes before a חטאת!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back on Step 5 and brings back its question.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 5 showed פר העלם דבר (a חטאת) coming before פר עבודה זרה (a עולה). But both are bulls, the same species, and there the חטאת always wins. The real trouble is פר עבודה זרה (a bull, עולה) coming before שעירי עבודה זרה (goats, חטאת). That is two species, and here the עולה wins, even though elsewhere a חטאת wins even when it is a bird.

keyTerms.meaning: one species, the same kind of animal
two species, different kinds of animals

phrases.english: In any event, with one species we did not say [there was a question],
that a sin offering comes first.
phrases.notes: Like פר העלם דבר and פר עבודה זרה from Step 5: both are bulls.

phrases.english: When we say [it is a difficulty], it is with two species:
we found a burnt offering that comes before a sin offering!
phrases.notes: The bull עולה of עבודה זרה is listed before the goat חטאות of עבודה זרה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects Step 5's answer by narrowing the problem to two different species.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Step 5's proof from פר העלם דבר coming before פר עבודה זרה
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: That proof is about one species, where a חטאת always comes first. The question was about two species.

steps.title: The sin offering of idol worship is missing an א
steps.stepSummary: In the name of רבא בר מרי, scholars in ארץ ישראל answer that the word for the חטאת of עבודה זרה is spelled 'לחטת', without an א. That missing letter shows it is different.
steps.simpleTranslation: In ארץ ישראל they say in the name of רבא בר מרי: the חטאת of עבודה זרה is missing an א. The פסוק writes 'לחטת'.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives a first answer to why the goat חטאות of עבודה זרה come after the bull עולה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The spelling of the word 'חטאת' is missing a letter in this פסוק. That shows this חטאת is weaker than a normal one. So it does not get the usual priority of a חטאת over a עולה.

keyTerms.meaning: in the West, meaning ארץ ישראל
'for a sin offering,' spelled without an א

phrases.aramaic: אָמְרִי בְּמַעְרְבָא מִשְּׁמֵיהּ דְּרָבָא בַּר מָרִי:
phrases.english: They say in the West in the name of Rava bar Mari:
The sin offering of idol worship is missing an alef.
"Lechatat" is written.
phrases.notes: במדבר 15:24

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמְרִי בְּמַעְרְבָא מִשְּׁמֵיהּ דְּרָבָא בַּר מָרִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the difficulty raised in Step 6.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Special exception derived from the spelling of the פסוק
steps.terutzHavaAmina: A חטאת always comes before a עולה, even across species.
steps.terutzMaskana: The חטאת of עבודה זרה is weaker, shown by the missing א, so it does not come first.

steps.title: The verse says 'according to the ordinance'
steps.stepSummary: רבינא gives a different answer. The פסוק about the offerings of עבודה זרה says 'כמשפט', which locks in the order the פסוק lists.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבינא says: the word 'כמשפט' (according to the ordinance) is written about them.
steps.whatsHappening: A second answer to Step 6's question.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבינא does not rely on spelling. The word 'כמשפט' tells us to bring these offerings in the exact order of the פסוק: bull first, then goat. That rule beats the usual priority of a חטאת.

keyTerms.meaning: according to the ordinance, the set order

phrases.english: Ravina said: "According to the ordinance" is written about them.
phrases.notes: Same פסוק, במדבר 15:24: the bull, then 'כמשפט', then the goat.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers a different answer from Step 7 to the same question.
steps.terutzResolutionType: The פסוק itself fixes the order
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The usual rule should put the goat חטאות first.
steps.terutzMaskana: 'כמשפט' requires the order of the פסוק, so the bull עולה goes first.

steps.title: The same answer saves the סוכות reading
steps.stepSummary: With רבינא's idea, the first ברייתא can be about the מוספין of סוכות after all, since 'כמשפטם' is written there too.
steps.simpleTranslation: Now that you have reached this idea, you can even say the ברייתא is about the bulls of the festival (סוכות). There too 'according to their ordinance' is written about them.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא goes back to Step 1 and uses רבינא's answer to bring back the סוכות reading that Step 2 had rejected.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 2 rejected the סוכות reading because the sheep עולות come before the goat חטאות. But the סוכות פסוקים also say 'כמשפטם', which fixes the order. So the problem goes away, and the ברייתא can be about סוכות.

keyTerms.meaning: now that you have come to this (idea)
the bulls of the festival, the מוספין of סוכות

steps.whatToRemember: When the פסוק says 'כמשפט' or 'כמשפטם', the order written in the פסוק wins, even over the usual rule that a חטאת comes before a עולה.

phrases.english: Now that you have come to this,
even if you say [it refers to] the bulls of the festival too,
phrases.notes: This goes back to Step 1's suggestion that the ברייתא was about סוכות.

phrases.english: "According to their ordinance" is written about them.
phrases.notes: במדבר פרק כט

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Applies רבינא's answer from Step 8 back to the first ברייתא.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Applying the same answer to an earlier case
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא cannot be about סוכות, because עולות come before חטאות there.
steps.terutzMaskana: 'כמשפטם' fixes the order at סוכות too, so the ברייתא can be about סוכות.
steps.whyThisMatters: Step 2 had rejected the סוכות reading. This step brings it back, so both readings of that ברייתא now work.

steps.title: Bird sin offering, animal burnt offering, or tithe: which comes first?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks about three offerings that beat each other in a circle. חטאת העוף beats עולת בהמה, עולת בהמה beats מעשר, and מעשר beats חטאת העוף.
steps.simpleTranslation: They asked: a bird חטאת, an animal עולה, and a מעשר offering. Which comes first? Should the bird חטאת go first? The מעשר comes before it. Should the מעשר go first? The animal עולה comes before it. Should the animal עולה go first? The bird חטאת comes before it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא raises a new question. It shows that each of the three offerings has another one that should come before it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each pair has a clear rule. A bird חטאת comes before an animal עולה, as we saw earlier. An עולה comes before מעשר. מעשר comes before birds. Put all three together and the rules go in a circle, so there is no clear first.

keyTerms.meaning: a question was asked before the חכמים

steps.confusionAlert: This is a true circle: each offering beats one of the others and loses to another. Do not look for one offering that beats both others. The next two steps give two ways to break the circle.

phrases.english: It was asked of them:
A bird sin offering, an animal burnt offering, and a tithe offering:
Which of them comes first?
Should the bird sin offering come first?
There is the tithe offering, which comes before it.
Should the tithe offering come first?
There is the animal burnt offering, which comes before it.
Should the animal burnt offering come first?
There is the bird sin offering, which comes before it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new question about precedence when three offerings each beat another in a circle.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: When a bird חטאת, an animal עולה and a מעשר offering are all waiting, which one is brought first?

steps.title: In בבל they say the slaughtered animal wins
steps.stepSummary: The scholars of בבל answer the circle question: being an offering that is slaughtered (מין זבח) is the strongest reason, so מעשר goes first.
steps.simpleTranslation: Here in בבל they explained: the kind of offering that is slaughtered is more important.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives its first answer to the circle problem from Step 10. In בבל they said one reason beats all the others.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 10 showed three offerings that each beat one other, so no order worked. בבל breaks the circle by saying that being a slaughtered animal (מין זבח) counts most. So מעשר, which is a slaughtered animal, comes first. After it comes חטאת העוף, which beats עולת בהמה.

keyTerms.meaning: a kind of offering that is slaughtered, an animal and not a bird

phrases.english: Here they explained:
phrases.notes: 'Here' means בבל, where this גמרא was put together.

phrases.english: the kind that is slaughtered is more important.
phrases.notes: So מעשר, an animal that is slaughtered, beats the bird חטאת.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the circle question of Step 10
steps.sheelahInformationSought: How to order three offerings that each beat one another
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Being a slaughtered animal is the strongest reason, so מעשר comes first, then חטאת העוף, then עולת בהמה

steps.title: In ארץ ישראל they say the bird sin offering gets lifted up
steps.stepSummary: The scholars of ארץ ישראל answer differently. The עולת בהמה that is being brought with the חטאת העוף lifts the חטאת העוף above the מעשר.
steps.simpleTranslation: In the West they say: the animal burnt offering affects the bird sin offering and raises it above the tithe.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives a second answer to the same circle problem, this time from ארץ ישראל.
steps.deeperAnalysis: חטאת העוף must come before the עולת בהמה. Because of that, it takes on the importance of an offering that outranks מעשר. So the order is חטאת העוף, then עולת בהמה, then מעשר. This is the opposite of בבל's answer, which put מעשר first.

keyTerms.meaning: in the West, meaning ארץ ישראל
enters into it, has an effect on it

steps.whatToRemember: The circle question gets two answers. בבל puts מעשר first, because a slaughtered animal counts most. ארץ ישראל puts חטאת העוף first, because the עולה it comes with lifts it up.

phrases.english: In the West they say:
phrases.notes: 'The West' is the usual גמרא way of saying ארץ ישראל.

phrases.english: the animal burnt offering has an effect on it,
on the bird sin offering,
and raises it above the tithe offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A different answer to the same question that Step 11 answered
steps.sheelahInformationSought: How to order the three offerings in the circle
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The עולת בהמה lifts the חטאת העוף above מעשר, so the order is חטאת העוף, then עולת בהמה, then מעשר

steps.title: Sin offerings come before guilt offerings, except the leper's
steps.stepSummary: A new משנה: every חטאת comes before an אשם, except the אשם of a מצורע, because that offering makes him fit.
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: All the sin offerings in the תורה come before the guilt offerings, except the guilt offering of a מצורע, because it comes to make him fit.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה starts. It gives a general rule that חטאת beats אשם, with one exception.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Usually a חטאת is offered before an אשם. The אשם of a מצורע is different, because it is part of what makes the healed מצורע fit (הכשר) to enter the holy areas. So in his case the אשם goes first.

keyTerms.meaning: משנה, the text the גמרא explains
the guilt offering of a healed leper

phrases.english: משנה:
All the sin offerings in the Torah
come before the guilt offerings,
except for the guilt offering of a מצורע,
because it comes to make him fit.
phrases.notes: His אשם is what lets the healed מצורע go back to eating and touching holy things.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new משנה after the previous discussion ends
steps.mimraCoreRuling: חטאת comes before אשם, except אשם מצורע, which comes first because it makes the מצורע fit

steps.title: Age and value of guilt offerings, with two exceptions
steps.stepSummary: Every אשם is a two-year-old ram worth silver shekels. The exceptions are אשם נזיר and אשם מצורע, which are first-year sheep and have no set value.
steps.simpleTranslation: All the guilt offerings in the תורה come as two-year-olds and come worth silver shekels. The exceptions are the guilt offering of a נזיר and of a מצורע: they come in their first year and do not need to be worth silver shekels.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives a second rule about אשמות: how old the animal is and how much it must be worth.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Most אשמות must be in their second year and worth a set amount of silver shekels. The אשם of a נזיר and the אשם of a מצורע are younger, in their first year, and have no minimum value.

keyTerms.meaning: worth silver shekels, a set minimum value
the guilt offering of a נזיר

phrases.english: All the guilt offerings in the Torah
come as animals in their second year
and come worth silver shekels,
phrases.notes: ויקרא 5:15. 'Shekels' in the plural is understood as at least two.

phrases.english: except the guilt offering of a נזיר and the guilt offering of a מצורע,
which come in their first year,
and do not need to be worth silver shekels.

steps.triggerLanguage: כָּל הָאֲשָׁמוֹת שֶׁבַּתּוֹרָה בָּאִין בְּנֵי שְׁתַּיִם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A second rule in the same משנה about אשמות
steps.mimraCoreRuling: An אשם is a second-year animal worth silver shekels, except אשם נזיר and אשם מצורע, which are first-year animals with no set value

steps.title: Whatever is offered first is eaten first
steps.stepSummary: The order used for offering also sets the order for eating. Between two שלמים, yesterday's is eaten before today's.
steps.simpleTranslation: Just as they come first in being offered, they come first in being eaten. If there are peace offerings from yesterday and peace offerings from today, yesterday's come before today's.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה carries the order of offering over to the order of eating. It then gives the first case: two שלמים from different days.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The earlier משנה (89a) said which offerings are brought first. Here the same order is used for eating the meat. When two offerings are the same kind (שלמים), the one from yesterday is eaten first.

keyTerms.meaning: eating the meat of the offering

phrases.english: Just as they come first in being offered,
phrases.notes: This points back to the order set in the earlier משנה on 89a.

phrases.english: they come first in being eaten.
Peace offerings from yesterday
and peace offerings from today:
yesterday's come before today's.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the order of offering to the order of eating
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The order of offering also sets the order of eating. Yesterday's שלמים are eaten before today's.

steps.title: Yesterday's peace offering versus today's sin offering
steps.stepSummary: A מחלוקת. רבי מאיר says yesterday's שלמים are eaten first. חכמים say today's חטאת comes first because it is קדשי קדשים.
steps.simpleTranslation: If there are peace offerings from yesterday and a sin offering or guilt offering from today, yesterday's peace offerings come first. These are the words of רבי מאיר. The חכמים say: the sin offering comes first, because it is of the most holy kind.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives a harder case, where two reasons pull in opposite directions, and רבי מאיר and חכמים disagree.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The שלמים are older, since they are from yesterday. The חטאת or אשם is holier, since it is קדשי קדשים. רבי מאיר lets the older offering win. חכמים let the holier offering win.

keyTerms.meaning: offerings of the most holy kind

steps.whatToRemember: Old versus holy. רבי מאיר says yesterday's שלמים are eaten first. חכמים say today's חטאת or אשם comes first, because it is קדשי קדשים.

phrases.english: Peace offerings from yesterday,
and a sin offering or guilt offering from today:
yesterday's peace offerings come first.
These are the words of רבי מאיר.
And the Sages say:
the sin offering comes first,
because it is of the most holy kind.

steps.triggerLanguage: שְׁלָמִים שֶׁל אֶמֶשׁ חַטָּאת וְאָשָׁם שֶׁל הַיּוֹם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Goes from the easy case of the same kind of offering to a case where age and holiness pull in different directions
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי מאיר: yesterday's שלמים are eaten first. חכמים: today's חטאת or אשם is eaten first, because it is קדשי קדשים.

steps.title: Priests may prepare the offerings any way they like, and a debate about תרומה spices
steps.stepSummary: The משנה rules that כהנים may eat the offerings roasted, boiled or cooked. רבי שמעון lets them add חולין or תרומה spices. רבי מאיר forbids תרומה spices so the תרומה will not become פסול.
steps.simpleTranslation: With all the offerings, the כהנים may eat them in any style: roasted, boiled or cooked. They may also put in plain spices or spices of תרומה. That is רבי שמעון's view. רבי מאיר says they may not put in תרומה spices, so that the תרומה does not end up disqualified.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the last line of the משנה. It says the כהנים may cook the קדשים however they like, and it records a מחלוקת about adding תרומה spices.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The way the offering is cooked does not matter, so roasting, boiling and cooking are all allowed. The only argument is about the spices. רבי מאיר worries that תרומה spices mixed into the קרבן will share its fate if the meat is left past its time and becomes פסול. רבי שמעון is not concerned about this.

keyTerms.meaning: The holy portion given to a כהן

steps.whatToRemember: The style of cooking is free. רבי מאיר only objects to תרומה spices, because they could become פסול together with the קרבן.

phrases.english: And with all of them, the priests are permitted
phrases.notes: "All of them" means all the offerings that get eaten, which the משנה was just discussing.

phrases.english: to vary the way they eat them
to eat them roasted, boiled, or cooked
phrases.notes: שלוקין means boiled very well, softer than regular cooking.

phrases.english: to put non-sacred spices into it
or spices of terumah.
These are the words of Rabbi Shimon.
Rabbi Meir says:
He may not put terumah spices into it,
so that he does not bring the terumah to disqualification.
phrases.notes: A קרבן can only be eaten for a limited time. If it goes past that time, the spices cooked into it get burned along with it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the משנה's rules about eating קדשים, moving from the order of eating to the manner of eating.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: כהנים may prepare the offerings in any cooking style. רבי שמעון allows תרומה spices and רבי מאיר forbids them, so the תרומה is not brought to פסול.

steps.title: Which comes first: the more frequent offering or the holier one?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what happens when the two rules of the משנה clash. Does the תדיר go first because it is frequent, or does the מקודש go first because it is holier?
steps.simpleTranslation: A question was asked: if one offering is more frequent and the other is holier, which goes first? Does the frequent one win because it is frequent? Or does the holier one win because it is holier?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens with a question. The משנה gave two rules for deciding which offering goes first, and now the גמרא asks what to do when those two rules point in opposite directions.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה taught that a תדיר offering comes first, and also that a more holy offering comes first. Each rule works fine on its own. The question is which rule is stronger when one offering is more frequent and the other is holier.

keyTerms.meaning: "It was asked of them": the חכמים raised a real question they were unsure about

steps.confusionAlert: This is not one offering against itself. It is two different offerings, where one wins on frequency and the other wins on holiness.
steps.whyThisMatters: It sets up the whole coming discussion, which tests different sources to see which rule is stronger.

phrases.english: GEMARA
A question was asked of them:
A frequent offering and a holier offering,
phrases.notes: Both rules come from the משנה on 89a: frequent comes first, and holier comes first.

phrases.english: which of them comes first?
Does the frequent one come first, because it is frequent,
or perhaps the holier one comes first, because it is holier?

steps.triggerLanguage: אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: תָּדִיר וּמְקוּדָּשׁ, אֵיזֶה מֵהֶם קוֹדֵם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא with a new question built on two precedence rules from the משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: When תדיר and מקודש conflict, which rule of precedence wins?

steps.title: A first attempt to answer from daily offerings before additional offerings
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא tries to settle the question from the משנה that תמידין come before מוספין.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: the daily offerings come before the additional offerings.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a source to try to answer the question. It quotes the first משנה of the פרק, which says the תמידין come before the מוספין.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תמיד is brought every day, so it is the more frequent offering. The גמרא is testing whether this case shows that frequency beats holiness. The discussion of whether this proof holds continues on the next amud.

keyTerms.meaning: The daily offerings brought every morning and afternoon
The additional offerings of שבת, ראש חודש and יום טוב

phrases.english: Come and hear:
The daily offerings come before the additional offerings.
phrases.notes: This is quoted from the first משנה of this פרק, on 89a.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Tries to answer the question of step 18 using an earlier משנה.
steps.raayaObject: That תדיר takes precedence over מקודש.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה on 89a: תמידין קודמין למוספין.
